description:
Outcome: Coordinator sees open reports and resolves them, from brief.md / First version 4.
Scope: Open report list, persistent resolution and gardener's own report status. Excludes: plot map/grid, payments, tool lending, attachments, public contact directory.
Acceptance: Repeat resolution safe; original plot/season association retained after reallocation; contacts coordinator-only.
Behaviour: Clear empty list, stale action and retry handling. All interfaces use phone-friendly large text, plain language, accessible labels and keyboard operation; server-side role/household authorization.
Verification: Role/state-transition and historical-association tests. Prerequisites: T-010. Assumptions: Editable March 1–October 31 defaults; garden timezone configured; coordinator-confirmed households; application receipt timestamp plus stable sequence for ties; preferences advisory; no automatic vacancy-offer expiry; 09:00 daily digest without empty emails. Framework/providers and finite retention periods settled in A/N. See setup handover.
title: Review and resolve plot problems
